steps.what: Show administrative staff already named on the record.
Mentor and support administrative staff members such as superintendents and principals.

tasks.design: The {HCM} store shows administrative staff already named, such as superintendents and principals. The education administrator mentors and supports those staff members. The record does not mentor anyone and it does not score them. Mentoring is not a staff evaluation. A person with no record stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mentoring was marked done because a staff name was on file, and the administrator had not spoken with them.
tasks.enabler_now: A staff name already stored can be opened. The mentoring still has to happen in conversation.
tasks.still_hard: What a principal needs to hear is still said in the conversation, not by the record.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator mentors and supports the staff member. The record only shows a name already stored.
tasks.altitude: Mentoring stays with the administrator. The staff record is only visible, and it is not an evaluation.

reach.learn: A staff record is not mentoring and not a score.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored staff name is a lookup. It does not mentor or support that person.
Mentoring is not a staff evaluation. A screen must not score a superintendent or a principal.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The staff id and the name already stored. The screen does not score the person and does not record mentoring as done. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the name before the conversation. Do not treat the record as an evaluation.
unknowns: Whether superintendents and principals share one staff list.
research_questions: What must be said in the conversation before mentoring is called done?

already_counted.description: Mentoring and supporting staff stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a staff name whose record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still mentors and supports administrative staff such as superintendents and principals. Only opening a name that was already stored is removed. The record does not mentor anyone and does not score them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect stored survey, regulatory, demographic, and employment counts.
Analyze trends and forecast enrollment patterns and curriculum change needs.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} store adds survey, regulatory, demographic, and employment counts that are already stored. The education administrator analyzes those counts and forecasts enrollment patterns and curriculum change needs. A missing count stops the line. The screen does not invent a trend and does not change the curriculum. A statistical program that already stores the counts is not this labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: A curriculum change was treated as required because a total looked large, and the administrator had not forecast it.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored counts can be added. The administrator still analyzes them and makes the forecast.
tasks.still_hard: Whether enrollment will change, and whether the curriculum should change, is still the administrator's forecast.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator forecasts. The screen only adds counts already stored.
tasks.altitude: The forecast stays with the administrator. Adding stored counts, and filing the accepted forecast, are the only parts removed.

reach.task: Receive a forecast this administrator has accepted.
reach.learn: A stored count is not a curriculum change.

evidence.claim: Adding stored survey, demographic, and employment counts is arithmetic. A missing count stops the line.
A forecast of enrollment and a curriculum change are judgements. A screen must not invent the trend or change the curriculum.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: A stored count with its id, period, and figure. A missing figure stops that line. The screen does not invent a trend. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Add a count only when the figure is already stored. Do not change the curriculum from the total.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the education administrator.
A statistical program that already stores the counts is not this labour. A missing count stops the line. The screen does not change the curriculum.
unknowns: Whether survey, regulatory, demographic, and employment counts share one table.
research_questions: Which stored count may enter the total before the administrator forecasts from it?

already_counted.description: Analyzing the counts and forecasting stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Retire a forecast whose source count was withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: enrollment forecast accepted by the education administrator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still analyzes the counts and forecasts enrollment patterns and curriculum change needs. Only adding figures that were already stored, and filing the accepted forecast, is removed. A statistical program that already stores the counts is not this labour, and the screen does not change the curriculum.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the facility record already held.
Advocate for schools to be built and for existing facilities to be repaired or remodeled.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the facility record already held. The education administrator advocates for new schools to be built or for existing facilities to be repaired or remodeled. The record does not make that case. A facility with no record leaves the advocacy with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: A repair was treated as agreed because a facility record existed, and the administrator had not made the case.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored facility can be opened. The advocacy still has to be made by the administrator.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a school should be built, repaired, or remodeled is still argued by the administrator.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator makes the case. The facility record is only what is already held.
tasks.altitude: Advocacy stays with the administrator. The stored facility is only visible.

reach.task: Hear the case this administrator makes.
reach.learn: A facility record is not the case for a repair.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored facility record is a lookup. It does not advocate for a school or a repair.
The case for building, repairing, or remodeling a school is a conversation. The record does not make it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The facility id and the record already stored. The screen does not mark a school as approved to be built or repaired. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the facility record before the administrator makes the case.
unknowns: Whether new-school cases and repair cases share one facility file.
research_questions: Who must hear the case before a school is called advocated for?

already_counted.description: Advocating for the school or the repair stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a facility whose record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still advocates for new schools to be built or for existing facilities to be repaired or remodeled. Only opening a facility record that was already held is removed. The record saves none of that advocacy.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored program names across particular school districts.
Establish, coordinate, and oversee programs to evaluate student academic achievement.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the program names already held across school districts. The education administrator establishes, coordinates, and oversees the programs and evaluates student academic achievement. The screen does not grade a student and does not decide a learning outcome. A program with no record stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: A student was treated as graded because a program name was on file, and the administrator had not evaluated the work.
tasks.enabler_now: A program name already stored can be opened. Establishing and evaluating the program still has to be done by the administrator.
tasks.still_hard: What a student has achieved is still the administrator's evaluation, not a program name.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator evaluates academic achievement. The screen only shows a program name already held.
tasks.altitude: Evaluation stays with the administrator. The stored program name is only visible, and no grade is filed.

reach.task: Host a program this administrator establishes and oversees.
reach.learn: A program name is not an evaluation of a student.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored program name is a lookup. It does not establish the program or evaluate a student.
Grading a student and deciding a learning outcome are decisions a person makes. A screen must not make them.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The program id and the name already stored. The screen does not grade a student and does not file a learning outcome. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the program name before the administrator evaluates. Do not file a grade.
unknowns: Whether programs across districts share one name list.
research_questions: Who evaluates student academic achievement, and where is that evaluation recorded?

already_counted.description: Establishing the program and evaluating achievement stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a program whose name has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still establishes, coordinates, and oversees programs and still evaluates student academic achievement. Only opening a program name that was already stored is removed. The screen does not grade a student and does not decide a learning outcome.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The education administrator still mentors staff, still forecasts enrollment, still advocates for facilities, and still evaluates student achievement. A stored count can be added. It does not make those judgements.
reach: Principals receive mentoring from this administrator. A staff record is not that mentoring.
Curriculum changes only when this administrator decides them. A stored count is not that change.
skills_to_grow: Mentor staff in the conversation. The record does not score them.
Forecast enrollment from counts already stored. A missing count stops the line.
Evaluate student achievement in person. The screen does not grade a student.
role.ambitious_version: Mentoring, forecasting, advocacy, and evaluation of achievement stay with the administrator. A stored count only adds figures a person already recorded.
